FORSHA 7

Class identity page for FORSHA 7, Bali Crystal College — one static file, no build step.

  • StatusLive
  • CategoryStatic site
  • Year2026
  • Stack4 technologies

Overview

A class identity page listing every member with photos and roles, rendered entirely from a single data array inside one HTML file.

Problem

The page had to show every member consistently — wall, gallery, search and profiles — while staying simple enough for anyone in the class to edit.

Approach

One index.html and one PEOPLE array. Every section is generated from that array, so a member is a single line of data rather than five copies of markup.

What is implemented

  • Single static HTML file — no framework, no bundler, no build step.
  • All members defined in one PEOPLE array as the single source of truth.
  • Class wall, gallery, search, profile and closing formation all render from that array.
  • GSAP and the Outfit font are vendored locally, so the page makes no third-party requests.

Contribution

Public repository under Dika's GitHub account (34 commits), including the data-driven rendering and the self-contained asset setup.

Architecture and data flow

A static index.html served directly by GitHub Pages. A PEOPLE array holds one entry per person; the wall, gallery, search, profile view and closing formation are all derived from it at runtime. Vendor assets (GSAP, Outfit) are stored in the repository so the page has no external dependencies.

Stack

HTML CSS Vanilla JavaScript GSAP

Known limitations
